notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention: bank 'b' holds rows f-j. The image's upper half (rows f-j) is therefore bank 'b'.

Column positions were read from the image: orange wire in column 3 row g; resistor from column 3 to column 6 in row h; LED legs in columns 6 (anode, bent/longer leg) and 8 (cathode), row i; black wire end in column 8 row h.
The orange wire goes to Uno pin 9. The black wire goes to the GND pin next to pin 13 (GND.1).
The resistor is 220 ohm per the schematic and the manual's hardware list.
